title: Relating to energy facility siting review timelines
sponsors: Senate Committee on Energy and Environment
committee: Senate Committee on Energy and Environment
summary: Modifies the review period for energy facility siting applications and directs the Energy Facility Siting Council to publish a determination within a fixed interval following a completed application.

title: Relating to regional transportation district governance
summary: Adjusts appointment procedures for the board of a mass transit district serving a metropolitan service district and revises reporting requirements to the regional government.
